findings.title: Vague, unreproducible 'app feels slower' complaint
findings.description: Customer reports a general sense that the platform feels 'heavier' or slower than in spring, but cannot identify which page, feature, device (laptop vs. phone), or date it occurred, and confirms nothing froze or errored. She agrees to capture the page, time, and device next time it happens. She also volunteers that their tasting-room wifi is poor and 'provisionally' blames that instead, noting it would explain most of her slowness complaints.
findings.quote: there's something, but I can't put my finger on it. It feels... I don't know, slower than it used to? Maybe?
findings.severity_reason: No confirmed defect, no reproducible symptom, and customer herself attributes it to her own known-poor local wifi rather than the product.
findings.match_note: Too unspecific to correspond to any tracked performance issue; no page, platform, or timing identified, unlike catalogued bugs which have concrete repro scope.

findings.title: Question about onboarding process for new second tasting-room location
findings.description: Customer asks whether staff at a new second tasting-room location (opening next spring, adding 8-10 year-round staff) would onboard the same way or require separate setup. Internal rep confirms they would simply be added to the existing account under one roster and one dashboard, with no separate setup needed. This is a process/account-configuration question, not a product defect or feature gap, and was fully resolved on the call.
findings.quote: Would the new tasting-room folks onboard the same way, or is there anything different for a second location?
findings.severity_reason: Informational question with no defect or unmet capability; already answered satisfactorily.
findings.match_note: Not a product bug or feature request; existing onboarding/licensing flow already supports this scenario as described, so no catalogue match applies.
